subject.title: feat: show OpenClaw sessions in Codex

question: Should the official `@openclaw/codex` package ship native sidebar-collection metadata before that contract exists in current public Codex source?
rationale: The fallback app can use supported plugin and MCP contracts, but adopting an unpublished host-only entrypoint creates a product and compatibility commitment that source review cannot authorize.

options.title: Gate native collections
options.body: Ship the fallback app and advertise the native collection only for a documented or pinned Codex capability with exact-host regression proof.

options.title: Own the experimental contract
options.body: Ship both entrypoints with explicit acceptance of the unpublished host dependency and an ongoing compatibility validation plan.

options.title: Defer native distribution
options.body: Pause the bundle until Codex publishes and supports the collection contract.

recommendation.title: Gate native collections
recommendation.body: Ship the fallback app and advertise the native collection only for a documented or pinned Codex capability with exact-host regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history owns the existing Codex extension and app-server integration surface, making him the strongest available product-boundary routing candidate.
